title: Crypt
summary: Encrypted secret sales with escrow and delivery disputes. The November 7 creator edit points to the open draft PR #1 README at abce0fe; the default branch still documents an older version. On November 12, Veil’s Esmeralda explorer displayed Crypt template 466c4da9…6deacbb, 23 functions and publication epoch 12934. The current README identifies template library 0.38 and Ootle 0.50.1. Its reported honest and disputed sales belong to the earlier November 3 template ed8116a0…03496c82 and used one demo wallet, not independent users. Disputes expose the secret; losing the sale key can prevent payouts. On November 12, server-side text extraction returned only a loading screen for the Vercel demo and could not retrieve the GitHub Pages demo; this does not establish their current interactive behavior. The November 3 browser checks found missing demo assets and a GitHub Pages 404. Earlier October 29 footage recorded a browser payout-signing limitation with 15 testnet XTM left in settled escrow. Those dated failures and prior recordings remain in maintenance history. This November 12 clip walks through the current README and its embedded creator animation; it is not a live application or transaction demonstration. BSD-3-Clause source. No wallet, executable download or local third-party code was used.
cardSummary: Explore encrypted secret sales, escrow and delivery disputes through a Rust template and its documented browser game.
